registers `dolos daemon` with this configuration to start at login, or at boot with `--system`

Usage: dolos service install [OPTIONS] [NAME]

Arguments:
  [NAME]  The instance's name, 1 to 48 of a-z, 0-9 and -; without it,
          `{chain.protocol}-{chain.network}` from the configuration

Options:
      --system           A system unit, started at boot and installed as root (Linux only), of the
                         file `--config` names; without it, the user's, started at login
      --start            Start it now as well
      --format <FORMAT>  How to print the result: text for people, JSON for scripts [default: text]
                         [possible values: text, json]
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
